statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (s δ : ℝ) (A : Set (YEuclid (n+1))) (V : ι → Set (YEuclid (n+1))), 0 < s → A ⊆ ⋃ i, V i → (∀ i, Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) → yContent s δ A ≤ ∑' i, Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s
proof:
intro ι hι s δ A V hs hcov hdiam
letI : Encodable ι := Encodable.ofCountable ι
let U : ℕ → Set (YEuclid (n+1)) := fun k => ⋃ b ∈ Encodable.decode₂ ι k, V b
have hUcov : A ⊆ ⋃ k, U k := by
  simpa only [U, Encodable.iUnion_decode₂] using hcov
have hUdiam : ∀ k, Metric.ediam (U k) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  intro k
  change Metric.ediam (⋃ b ∈ Encodable.decode₂ ι k, V b) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ
  apply Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_cases (C := fun B => Metric.ediam B ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ)
  · simp
  · exact hdiam
have hle : yContent s δ A ≤ ∑' k, Metric.ediam (U k) ^ s := by
  unfold yContent
  exact iInf_le_of_le U (iInf_le_of_le hUcov (iInf_le_of_le hUdiam le_rfl))
refine hle.trans_eq ?_
exact tsum_iUnion_decode₂ (fun B : Set (YEuclid (n+1)) => Metric.ediam B ^ s) (by simp [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hs]) V

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YEuclid n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ), yCritical (YEuclid m)) ∧ yCritical ℝ →
    (dimH E < ∞ ∧
        0 ≤ dimH E ∧
          dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
            (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ (∃ x, E = {x}) ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → yContent s δ E < ∞) →
      (1 ≤ n →
          ∀ (q r ε : ℝ),
            0 < q →
              dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
                0 < r →
                  r ≤ 1 →
                    0 < ε →
                      ∃ U,
                        yCover r E U ∧
                          (∀ (i : ℕ), (U i).Nonempty → 0 < Metric.ediam (U i)) ∧ yCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
        ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (s δ : ℝ) (A : Set (YEuclid (n + 1))) (V : ι → Set (YEuclid (n + 1))),
          0 < s →
            A ⊆ ⋃ i, V i →
              (∀ (i : ι), Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) → yContent s δ A ≤ ∑' (i : ι), Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s
